beforeShellExecution.command: sh -c 'g=/opt/agent-guard; [ -r $g/hook.sh ] && [ -r $g/$1 ] && exec sh $g/hook.sh "$1"; [ -d /exec-daemon ] || { h=$(git show origin/main:tools/agent-guard/hook.sh 2>/dev/null) && exec sh -c "$h" origin/main "$1"; }; r="git -C /workspace fetch -q origin main && git -C /workspace show origin/main:tools/agent-guard/boot.sh | bash -s -- /workspace"; e=$(cat); case $1:$e in sh*:*\"command\"*\"command\"*) ;; sh*:*"\"command\":\"$r\""*|sh*:*"\"command\": \"$r\""*) echo "{\"permission\":\"allow\"}"; exit;; esac; m="Refused by .cursor/hooks.json: this machine has no readable $g/hook.sh and $g/$1, the copy of the agent guard from origin/main that boot.sh puts there at boot, and the guard never runs the copy in a checkout. Until it is back every shell command but the one below and every Task and MCP call is refused, while reading and editing files still work. Restore it with exactly this command: $r"; echo "{\"permission\":\"deny\",\"agent_message\":\"$m\",\"user_message\":\"$m\"}"' guard shell_hook.py
